# V2.4.2 - Watcher

Dictation keeps the message in your draft until the final transcript is ready. Pressing Send or queuing a follow-up while recording no longer sends a partial message. Releasing push-to-talk during microphone setup cancels the recording, and switching windows won't send your words to another draft.

You can now collapse a question to read the conversation behind it. Expand it to continue where you left off, including any answer you were typing.
